description.p: Open PDF Studio is a free, open-source PDF editor and annotator for people who work with drawings and documents every day: architects, engineers, contractors, and anyone who needs solid tools without a subscription.

ul.li: Import DWG and DXF drawings as vector PDF, with the CAD layers as PDF layers and a measuring scale
Export a page back to DXF or DWG, with layers, at real size
Measure distance, area and perimeter with scale calibration and scale regions
Parametric symbols, walls and beams that stay to scale
More than 22 annotation tools: highlights, shapes, freehand drawing, text boxes, callouts, notes, stamps and images
Compare two PDFs side by side and list every change
Verify digital signatures, recognise text (OCR) in scans, edit existing text, fill forms and redact permanently
Insert, delete, extract, reorder, replace and merge pages; add watermarks, headers and footers
Print to scale with a live preview, including large sheets up to A0
Export pages as PNG, JPEG or raster PDF, and annotations as XFDF

description.p: Also: multi-tab editing with session restore, five themes, 39 languages, and no telemetry, no data collection and no subscriptions.

ul.li: Text edits refuse characters that no available font can show
Letter-spaced text opens without extra spaces
Redo and MCP text replacements update the text layer

description.p: Annotation hover cursors, selection borders, and panel resize improvements.
